positive_snippets:
I stayed at Stay Hotel and overall my experience was very good. The room was clean, well-maintained, and comfortable. Housekeeping was done on time and hygiene was properly maintained.
The staff was polite, supportive, and quick to help whenever needed. Check-in and check-out process was smooth and hassle-free. The hotel atmosphere was calm and suitable for both family and solo stay.
Location is convenient, with easy access to nearby markets and transport. Food quality was decent; breakfast options were limited but fresh.

My stay at The Orion Plaza, Nehru Place was quite pleasant. The location is excellent — very close to the metro station and easily accessible to nearby markets and restaurants. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The staff was polite and cooperative, always ready to help with any requests. The breakfast spread was decent and served on time.

Overall, it’s a good value-for-money stay in South Delhi, especially for business or short trips. Would definitely consider staying here again.
Thanks to Amit, Aashif and sahil

Rooms could be a bit spacious and cleaner but hotel staff is very friendly and accommodating. Location wise good as located on main road with good connectivity with public transport and metros. Food at restaurant was very good, please note outside food is not allowed
negative_snippets:
I stayed at Orion Plaza in New Delhi and had a very disappointing experience. The front office reception was extremely rude when we checked in around 10 PM. There was clearly missing communication between Agoda and the hotel management, which caused unnecessary hassle at arrival.

The room condition was far from what was advertised. Although they claim the rooms are clean, they did not look clean at all. There was visible mold around the bathroom tap and inside the shower cubicle. The shower area also felt poorly maintained and unhygienic.

No room service was provided during our stay, and the flooring in the room looked damaged and worn out. For the price and the way the hotel is marketed, the experience was below standard.
Overall, I would not recommend Orion Plaza. Poor customer service, lack of cleanliness, and weak management communication made the stay unpleasant. Definitely not worth it.
